fields.summary_ko.0: Samsung Electronics price target lowered 17% from KRW 350,000 to KRW 290,000; SK hynix lowered 14% from KRW 2.1 million to KRW 1.8 million, maintaining buy ratings.
fields.summary_ko.1: Stock prices expected to rebound from next spring driven by improved HBM performance and expanded AI investments, though expected to decline from Q2 2027 peak.
fields.summary_ko.2: KB Securities expects memory supply shortage to continue through 2028, with 2027 server DRAM and enterprise SSD demand projected to increase 56% and 54% respectively.
